trust.sourcesText: Exchange feeds and licensed data vendors, each named on the screen where it appears.
trust.labelsText: Every block carries its type: market data, AI explanation, technical signal, community opinion or sponsored.
trust.aiTitle: What AI does and does not do
trust.aiText: AI explains and structures. It never recommends an instrument, and its output is always labelled.
trust.signalsText: Technical readings describe price behaviour. They are not instructions to buy or sell.
trust.sponsoredText: Paid placements are marked as sponsored wherever they appear, including inside news lists.
trust.neverText: No guaranteed returns, no "you should buy", no performance promises of any kind.
